name: Thief
notes: Manipulates awareness, shadows, locks, pickpocketing and alternate routes (CONSTITUTION): climbs rough stone where others need a rope. Grows through tools on the belt, tricks from contacts and deeds (ADR-0004). Lockpicks in the kit grant tool.lockpick while carried. Grey-box kit: knife, leather and lockpicks.
pitch: A shadow the city pays well. Slip past, climb where others cannot, take what you like.
